doc: A random 64x32 float32 field resampled to width 24 by sample_equirect at the texel-center directions (bilinear, longitude wraps, latitude clamps, no prefiltering: a downsample aliases): float64 interpolation rounded to float32, default tolerance (measured worst difference against an analytic-index float64 evaluation 1.1e-7, one ulp). The output rows all lie between source row centers: no latitude clamp.
